## Type

- [ ] `fix` — corrects a wrong claim / link / number
- [ ] `docs` — improves existing documentation
- [ ] `i18n` — translation fix or new translation
- [ ] `feat` — new section or new example
- [ ] `bench` — benchmark reproduction added
- [ ] `tool` — community tool added to `resources/awesome-community.md`
- [ ] `chore` — governance / templates / meta
